policy: These are semantic questions, not declarations that published edges are incorrect; inspect primary scholarly sources before any migration.

candidates.issue: FM is primarily a training objective for continuous normalizing flows rather than a descendant of the entire normalizing-flow model family.
candidates.review_requirement: Check conditional probability paths and CNF class in Lipman et al. (ICLR 2023).

candidates.issue: Song et al. present a continuous-time unifying framework encapsulating prior score/diffusion modeling; simple successor history may misrepresent the conceptual relation.
candidates.review_requirement: Read the abstract/introduction and separate temporal scientific influence from equivalence/unification.

candidates.issue: VAE uses amortized variational inference as a training/inference mechanism. A symmetric-looking hybrid genealogy edge may obscure the relation between model architecture and inference procedure.
candidates.review_requirement: Read original ELBO, encoder, decoder and stochastic gradient sections.

candidates.issue: Kalman-style ensemble updates are adapted to inversion, but EKI and filtering solve different inferential tasks. Check historic direct descent and exact formulation.
candidates.review_requirement: Check Iglesias et al. (2013) and earlier filtering literature before changing type.

candidates.issue: Physics residual losses used in PINO derive from a broader physics-informed training principle, not necessarily the full PINN algorithm as a fused component.
candidates.review_requirement: Identify specifically inherited loss/supervision components in PINO paper.

candidates.issue: Physics-informed operator loss may be a mechanism shared with PINNs, not integration of both full model architectures.
Direct inverse operator uses physics constraints; need to distinguish physical consistency loss from PINN architectural composition.
candidates.review_requirement: Review primary PI-DION paper and clarify which mechanism is transferred.

candidates.issue: Extension is plausible as application of guided score sampling, but should record approximate posterior nature and observation-guidance assumptions, not unconditional exact Bayes inference.
candidates.review_requirement: Check Chung et al. (ICLR 2023) and exact sampling guarantees; avoid any clinical effectiveness inference.

candidates.issue: Plausible direct methodological development, but the displayed edge should not imply validated clinical intervention planning.
candidates.review_requirement: Preserve distinction between control environments and coronary virtual PCI.

candidates.issue: Damped Gauss–Newton relation is defensible; historic sources and the distinction between regularization damping and modern trust-region variants should be clearly described.
candidates.review_requirement: Separate Levenberg/Marquardt contributions and mathematical variants.
